# Merchant Juice on UnnamedTome

The eleventh natural Stygian/Awoken sample (seed73751504) reaches Ring7
with merchant Juice on UnnamedTome card24. Version0.2.105 globally refuses
the uncalibrated owner, including plain deployment. The original one-input
native refusal is preserved in `player-juice-tome-calibration.mt2f`.

Version0.2.106 accepts only owner`561f7a74-93a3-438f-9bfd-fbc84d979bdd`,
ordered ordinary Permafrost0/Exhaust0/Juice2 and the single permanent merchant
upgrade`0fc9f6e7-df71-4045-9867-67453769adf8`. Its draw callback may append
one ordinary temporary Freeze0. Other trait orders, owners, scaling callbacks
and upgrades remain guarded. Existing doubling, Freeze and Consume physics
are reused.

Two independent native processes execute the same14-input prefix. The15th
input casts card24 at Turn2 into room0, with enemies12,13,14,15. Each receives
six muted stacks instead of the authored three; the three spell-shield owners
retain both shield stacks. Energy and health stay unchanged, the card is
consumed, and source-attributed status statistics increase by24. The drawn
card has exactly one temporary Freeze before the cast. Every root, successor,
forecast and RNG matches, including the old refusal's original root.

Eight parallel branches preserve their parent, and twelve owner/scaling/trait/
upgrade controls reject changed signatures, including a nonordinary Freeze.
MagicJuice, Ritual of Battle, Fracture, JustCause and returned Permafrost
Benediction focused native checks pass. Original game files remain unchanged.
This component calibration is distinct from a full default Ring7 victory.

scripts/Check-Models.ps1 -Fixture player-juice-tome-calibration.mt2f -SkipBuild
